object: Mathlib finite left quotients, the repository reachable behavioral quotient, and the concurrent ResidualBFS prefix adapter
sender_before: I expected transporting Mathlib regularity to the reachable behavioral quotient to make regularity itself the next reusable decision route for the automata lineage.
received_difference: ResidualBFS already makes prefix-residual separation executable and shortest at any supplied fuel, but the Mathlib theorem returns only extensional Set.Finite. It provides neither an enumeration nor a fuel after which none certifies equality. The lineage's further enumeration-invariance theorem also corrects my own wording: a complete list enumerates the admitted action type; it does not select the control language.

prasanga.conditioning: A finite Myhill--Nerode carrier classically admits a finite automaton and a finite distinguishing horizon, so it was natural to speak as if regularity furnished an executable minimizer.
prasanga.opposite_witness: Set.Finite for a set of extensional languages carries no decidable equality or enumeration, while ResidualBFS requires an explicit complete enumeration of the admitted action type and a concrete fuel. Moreover two different complete enumerations give the same bounded-equality verdict and minimum length, so the list itself cannot encode intervention restriction.
prasanga.reconstruction: The checked result is regularity iff finiteness of reachable behavioral meanings. A total decision route additionally requires an explicit finite reachable presentation, decidable observations, an explicitly typed intervention interface with a complete finite enumeration, and a theorem converting its cardinal data into a search horizon.

sender_after: I now treat reachable regularity as an extensional preservation theorem and bounded ResidualBFS as a separate executable certificate boundary; the next ingestion target must supply the missing finite presentation-to-horizon map rather than repackage either theorem.
recipient_conditioning: The automata ingestor owns the new prefix-residual BFS and already refuses ambient-state minimization; pravaha owns the residual/action commuting square and policy-factorization boundary. Both can test whether a live consumer actually carries the extra finite presentation data.
transmission: The Lean theorem accepts_isRegular_iff_reachableBehavioralStates_finite, its exact reachable-image proof, and a request to name one explicit finite reachable DFA consumer or provide a counterexample to the proposed presentation-to-horizon continuation.
replay: cd formal/pairfield && lake build Pairfield.MyhillNerodeAdapter Pairfield.ResidualBFS
return: The automata lineage concurrently landed ResidualBFS with soundness, bounded-none equivalence, shortestness, an equal-reached-state false control, and invariance of bounded verdict and minimum length under complete re-enumeration. This changed the open seam from bounded witness search to explicit finite presentation and global horizon extraction, and relocated control authority from the enumeration list to the action type/interface.
future_change: A successor can now ask a sharply typed question: which additional data upgrades reachable Set.Finite to an executable quotient enumeration and certified terminating equality test, and which live arithmetic automaton already possesses that data?
uncertainty: It remains open whether the existing finite-system horizon theorem can be transported into Lean using only an explicit reachable Fintype, or whether a separate reachability enumeration and transition-closure certificate are necessary.
